body:
NoPlaceDelay

Tired of that annoying pause between block placements? NoPlaceDelay eliminates the built-in 4-tick delay so you can place blocks as fast as you click.

---

🔧 What does it do?

In vanilla Minecraft, every time you place a block there is a forced 4-tick (~200ms) cooldown before you can place another one. This makes rapid building feel sluggish and unresponsive.

NoPlaceDelay removes this restriction entirely — the moment you right-click, the next block is ready to go. Whether you're speed-bridging, building massive structures, or just placing a few blocks, everything feels instant and smooth.

---

✨ Features

• ⚡ Zero placement delay — place blocks back-to-back with no cooldown

• 🖱️ Works with hold & click — both clicking rapidly and holding right-click benefit

• 🪶 Lightweight — a tiny client-side mixin, no performance impact

• 🔌 Plug and play — drop it in your mods folder and go
